ModMetaData.description: Important: This mod should be placed right below Core and expansions in the mod list to work properly! Requires RimWorld 1.7\n This build is a RimWorld 1.7 port of the Multiplayer mod (github.com/seatemplar10-dev/Multiplayer, branch waylith-1.7-port, protocol 57; based on StephenSHorton rw-1.7). It does not need Prepatcher.\n Multiplayer mod for RimWorld. FAQ - https://hackmd.io/@rimworldmultiplayer/docs/ Discord - https://discord.gg/S4bxXpv
